subject: general
question: Mission Indradhanush is related with which of the following government schemes?
solution:
The correct answer is **Child Vaccination**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Indradhanush** was launched by the Government of India in December 2014.
 
• The mission aims to cover all those children who are either unvaccinated or are partially vaccinated against seven vaccine-preventable diseases.
 
• The diseases targeted are Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Polio, Tuberculosis, Measles, and Hepatitis B.
 
• The mission also aims to improve the coverage of vaccines in areas with low immunization rates.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
